KO.rationale: Coca-Cola possesses an elite consumer franchise — asset-light concentrate model, 45%+ global sparkling share, 62%+ gross margins, 40.4% ROE, and 64 consecutive years of dividend increases. Q1 2026 results were strong: EPS $0.86 vs $0.81 consensus (+6.17% beat), organic revenue +10% (8% volume + 2% price/mix), operating margin expanding ~70bp to 33.8%. However, the stock is priced at the ceiling of its 1-year PE range (28.45x, window 23.2–28.9x), with a negative earnings-yield-to-Treasury spread of -97bp (3.5% vs 4.47%). Oil at $104.66/bbl (+67% over lookback) creates a tangible input-cost headwind for PET resin and freight that has not yet materialized in reported margins. The quant data window is narrow (only two quarters), and Q1 operating cash flow was deeply negative (-$5.20B), flagging cash-flow volatility. The market has already re-rated the stock in lockstep with margin expansion — price sits just 1.9% below the 365-day high. This is a high-quality franchise at a full price with macro headwinds building, warranting a mildly positive but constrained score.
key_factors: Structurally high gross margins (62.2% Q2-2025, trailing 61.4%) and elite ROE (40.4%) confirm franchise quality

PE at ceiling of 1-year range: 28.45x (window 23.2–28.9x); earnings yield 3.5% vs 10Y Treasury 4.47% = negative 97bp spread
Oil at $104.66/bbl (+67.4% over lookback) creates margin headwind for PET resin, freight, distribution not yet visible in reported quarters
Q1-2025 operating cash flow deeply negative at -$5.20B, signaling cash-flow volatility despite clean Q2-2025 conversion ($3.81B OCF vs $3.80B net income)
64-year consecutive dividend increase streak affirmed at $0.53/quarter; Berkshire Hathaway maintains ~9.2-9.4% position with no near-term liquidation risk per Greg Abel
CCBA divestiture creates ~4% revenue headwind in 2026 but improves capital-light profile; 60%+ portfolio now low/no-sugar options
Debt-to-equity ~2.46x ($74.15B liabilities on $30.18B equity) — manageable for investment-grade staples but not conservative
